alex: Heads up — PR #18422 is blocked, the coverage gate fails only on `integration-smoke`.

maria: which test is failing? can you paste the error?

alex: coverage diff shows `auth/permission_test` jumped 2.3% on shard 5. logs look like flakes, not real regression.

sam: @alex can you trigger a targeted rerun? I can watch.

alex: sure — running targeted rerun for shard 5 now via Buildkite.

alex: ```
buildkite-agent pipeline upload .buildkite/pipelines/ci-smoke-shard.yml --env SHARD=5
``` 

ci-bot: Job started: buildkite-smoke-shard-5 (id: bk-99231) :rocket:

jen: FYI we still need 2 approvals for merge (only @sam has lgtm). @maria can you take a look?

maria: I'll skim and either approve or request changes in 30m. quick question — is this PR changing test timeout values or is it infra-only?

alex: infra only (test harness tweak). no test logic change.

ci-bot: Job passed: buildkite-smoke-shard-5 (id: bk-99231) :white_check_mark:

sam: :thumbsup: rerun green. alex can you update the PR description to note rerun and link the CI job? then we can merge once maria approves.

alex: done — added CI link + note about non-regression.

maria: looks fine, approving now. :eyes:

sam: merging after green and approvals. heads-up to follow-up with ops to monitor coverage alert for next week.

alex: will do, thanks all :pray:
